Metalix Table Lamp Metal Neck LED & Phone Stand – Premium Fold-Flat Desk Lamp

Upgrade your workspace and bedside setup with the Metalix Table Lamp Metal Neck LED & Phone stand, a modern lighting solution designed for performance, portability, and style. Crafted with a premium metal neck lamp body, this lamp combines durability with a sleek aesthetic that complements home offices, study tables, bedrooms, and corporate desks. Its smart engineering and elegant finish make it an ideal choice for users who value functionality without compromising on design.

The lamp features a fold-flat design with a 180° adjustable hinge, allowing you to direct light exactly where you need it or fold it completely flat for easy storage and travel. Whether you are working late, reading, attending online meetings, or relaxing with your phone, this lamp adapts effortlessly to your routine. The integrated Phone Stand adds hands-free convenience, making it perfect for video calls, watching content, or following recipes.

Smart Lighting with Eye Comfort

Designed to reduce eye strain, the Metalix lamp offers 3 light modes (warm, cool, and neutral) to match different activities and moods. Warm light is ideal for relaxation and night reading, cool light enhances focus for work or study, while neutral light provides balanced illumination for everyday use. With flicker-free and glare-free LED technology, this lamp supports long hours of comfortable usage.

The Touch-sensitive control panel allows effortless switching between light modes and brightness levels with a simple tap. No mechanical buttons, no noise—just smooth, intuitive control that adds to the lamp’s premium feel.

Rechargeable & Cordless Convenience

Powered by a long-lasting 2400 mAh battery, the Metalix Table Lamp delivers reliable illumination without being tied to a power outlet. The efficient LED system ensures extended usage on a single charge, making it suitable for power cuts, travel, and flexible desk arrangements. With fast and modern Type-C Charging, recharging is quick, universal, and hassle-free.

The cordless design keeps your workspace clutter-free and minimal, while the stable metal base ensures balance and durability. This makes the lamp a practical option for students, professionals, content creators, and anyone seeking a premium rechargeable desk lamp.

Why Choose the Metalix Premium Metal Neck Lamp?

  • Premium metal neck lamp with modern, durable construction
  • Fold-flat design with a 180° adjustable angle for flexible lighting
  • Built-in phone stand for hands-free viewing and video calls
  • 3 light modes (warm, cool, and neutral) for every activity
  • Touch-sensitive control for smooth and silent operation
  • Type-C Charging for fast, universal compatibility
  • High-capacity 2400 mAh battery for long cordless use
  • Energy-efficient LED desk lamp with eye-care technology

Perfect for Multiple Use Cases

The Metalix Table Lamp Metal Neck LED & Phone stand is ideal for home offices, corporate workstations, study desks, bedside tables, and travel kits. Its compact foldable form makes it easy to carry, while the sturdy metal build ensures long-term performance. Whether you need a rechargeable LED desk lamp, a study lamp with phone stand, or a premium bedside table lamp, Metalix delivers versatility in one smart product.

Optimized for modern lifestyles, this lamp also makes an excellent corporate gift, promotional product, or premium accessory for tech-savvy users. Its combination of elegant design, advanced lighting modes, and practical features aligns perfectly with current trends in smart desk lighting.

Choose the Metalix lamp for a refined lighting experience that blends innovation, comfort, and durability. Designed to meet everyday needs while enhancing your space, it stands out as a reliable and stylish LED table lamp with phone stand.
